newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander shares uninspired by H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Santander shares uninspired by H1 results.

text.p: Shares in Spain's Santander remained depressed in a generally weak market on Tuesday after the bank reported first half results at the top end of expectations, dealers said.
"These results look better than expected at first glance," said one dealer. "Santander is down in line with other banks and the market, and volume is very thin."

Santander said its net attributable profit for the first half had risen 30.2 percent to 59.78 billion pesetas. A Reuter poll earlier in July showed that economists expected on average a 20.8 percent rise in net attributable income.
At 1000 GMT, shares were down 30 pesetas, or 0.7 down at 4,240 while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares was down 0.81 percent at 6,762.23.
Dealers said they were awaiting more details of the results from an analysts meeting which started at 0900 GMT.
